confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate from general knowledge of Japanese regional pricing, not checked against live listings. Restaurant and drink anchors are the more reliable part; accommodation is lower confidence because Tottori has a small hotel and hostel market and summer rates vary. Yen-based values assume roughly 150 JPY per USD. The FX observation comes from the RBA homepage snippet for 15 October 2026 as shown in search results; I did not open the F11.1 table to confirm it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Japanese regional prefectural capitals of similar size and tourism profile, such as Matsue, priced below Kyoto and Tokyo. Accommodation is anchored to the Tottori Station area, where most visitors stay.
